# x86_64 Nginx core

The executable is intentionally not committed to the source repository.

Build it natively on an x86_64 Debian/Ubuntu host:

```bash
./scripts/build-nginx.sh x86
```

Expected output path:

```text
third_party/nginx/x86_64/nginx
```

The FnProxy 0.1.0 x86 release used Nginx 1.30.4 with SHA-256:

```text
90b9e538d29a481f071a53877cb9f957b0a5fd38416fea84d5c89eba78e60cb4
```
